newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: PSC stock to requote on Wednesday.
newsitem.headline: PSC stock to requote on Wednesday.

text.p: The stock of Malaysia's PSC Industries Bhd will be requoted on Wednesday, the Kuala Lumpur Stock Exchange said in a statement on Tuesday.
Shipbuilder and marine firm PSC on Monday announced a proposal to raise its shareholding in Naval Dockyard Sdn Bhd to 58 percent through various acquisitions.
It now holds 28 percent equity in the dockyard and had proposed in December to raise its stake to 44 percent through a subsidiary.
The stock was suspended from January 2 being last traded at 31.25 ringgit.
